name: 2026-10-12-soffit-windows-ledge
note: Sales floor from the owner's 12 Oct photos and the 6 Oct scan: the drop-ceiling soffit ends at the north column row (y 21.5, was 33); the arch wall is open above the arches to the offices above (3 openings, no glass); two glass windows in the soffit fascia; the clerestory windows on the north part of the arch wall are gone and it has the FBS bucket ledge instead.

set.name: Sales floor ceiling (vaulted tile)
set.toConfirm: Owner, 12 Oct (photos of aisle 3B and the DeWalt view): the drop-ceiling soffit ends at the north row of columns. The owner's 6 Oct LiDAR scan agrees: the 9.7-10 ft drop ceiling stops and the fascia rises to the vaulted ceiling at y 21-22 across the whole sales floor (x 50-103). Was y 33. TO CONFIRM with a tape: the soffit line against the columns.

set.name: Arch wall (grid E)
set.toConfirm: Owner, 12 Oct: no windows on this part of the arch wall; it has a ledge where the FBS buckets stand (owner photo by the Makita row). Ledge top from the scan (about 12.6 ft there, the scan reads about 0.6 ft low against the ceilings): 13.2 ft, about 1.5 ft deep. Note: the scan puts this wall's sales-floor face 4-5 ft further west (about x 97.5 below the ledge, 99 above) than the map's x 103; not moved, TO CONFIRM with a tape before anything is planned against this wall.

set.name: Opening to the offices above (over arch 1)
set.toConfirm: Owner, 12 Oct: above the arches the wall is open (no glass) to the offices above the front room (owner photo from the Kreg display). Three openings, one over each arch, with narrow piers between them over the wall piers; they reach up to the ceiling. Sill and head from the photo and the scan; TO CONFIRM with a tape: sill height, and where each opening starts and ends.
